application_review: Every original lattice-rational subspace is real-spanned by vectors whose actual original exponentials lie in Gamma. Positive integer powers clear each vector; Log Gamma is not assumed additive. Applied to the actual Lie lower-central layers, this supplies layerwise true lattice exponential spanning sets.

The full original graded polynomial-array coefficient algebra is spanned by monomials with coefficients in those genuine exponential lattice sets. Each such monomial exponentiates to an integer power of one original Gamma element at EVERY integer input. Consequently all-integer lattice coefficient vectors real-span the entire coefficient algebra.

The actual pointwise array lattice is pulled back through the proved array equivalence to the finite evaluation image and then included into the original finite product. The exact exponential membership criterion retains every integer input. Its actual original logarithms real-span the entire finite evaluation Lie image.

The specified original lattice has a genuine recursively constructed lattice in the actual finite group product; its inherited topology is discrete and its original coset quotient is compact. The all-integer array lattice is proved contained in this product lattice through selected evaluations.

A subgroup of a specified original lattice with a prescribed real logarithmic span has the exact rational intersection in that lattice rational form. This proves rationality of its real span and positive-root coverage of every lattice point in the corresponding original Lie subgroup.

Rational character dimension descent produces compact representatives using only the specified subgroup: each original lattice pivot is replaced by a proved positive power in that subgroup. Strict dimension descent, actual character scaling and subgroup closure are checked. No finite-index, cocompactness or normality premise about that subgroup is assumed.

The full finite evaluation image modulo the actual all-integer lattice is compact. Transfer by the actual continuous group equivalence gives compactness of the actual array group modulo its exact pointwise Gamma-valued lattice. Together with the prior finite selection theorem this proves existence of a simply connected array group with a discrete cocompact specified lattice for finite input-variable types.

Reviewed original-statement fidelity: the lattice membership predicate quantifies over all integer inputs, including negative inputs and zero, using literal integer monomial powers. There is one fixed coefficient vector per array.

Reviewed the rational span bridge: real-span equality alone is not used to infer rational equality in an arbitrary real vector space. The proof invokes the original discrete cocompact ambient lattice rational-form intersection theorem and the proved containment in that same lattice.

Reviewed root character descent: the original rational-subspace descent is on strictly smaller real dimension. Every selected pivot has an actual positive power in the target subgroup, the character value stays nonzero, and membership in the current Lie subgroup persists under powers. No finite-index theorem is silently assumed.

Reviewed final quotients: the finite ambient lattice is the image of the full pointwise lattice, and comap-map equality uses the injective subgroup inclusion. The final quotient transfer uses the actual continuous surjective array equivalence; no lattice normality is required.
